## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Add support for **Shelly Pro 3EM energy counters** (follow up of https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/86403)

**Note:** Needs firwmare `0.13.0-beta3` and above

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1858925/216695876-cd723a20-0c31-4bb0-9436-3f97d04227fa.png)
Documentation of the `emdata` component which is used to create the sensors data is here:
https://shelly-api-docs.shelly.cloud/gen2/ComponentsAndServices/EMData

New `emdata` counters added to `NotifyStatus`:
```json
    "emdata:0": {
        "id": 0,
        "a_total_act_energy": 16.84,
        "a_total_act_ret_energy": 0.00,
        "b_total_act_energy": 16.84,
        "b_total_act_ret_energy": 0.00,
        "c_total_act_energy": 80.84,
        "c_total_act_ret_energy": 41.71,
        "total_act": 114.53,
        "total_act_ret": 41.71
    }
```

**Big thanks to Shelly for fast acting on this issue.**

issue_context.title: Shelly Pro 3EM Energy Entities not supported by the Shelly integration
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Hi, 

It appears that the relatively new [Shelly Pro 3EM](https://www.shelly.cloud/en/products/shop/pro-3-em) device is not yet fully supported by the [Shelly integration](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/shelly/). Reboot, temperature, firmware, RSSI and some other basic entities are loading well, but the energy-related entities aren't. Enabling outbound websockets per the [instructions](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/shelly/#shelly-device-configuration-generation-2) and performing the integration from scratch has not resolved the issue.

Is there a plan to update the integration to support the new device?

Thanks a lot!

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.1.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2023.1.4

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

Shelly

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/shelly/

_No response_

Sorry for the off topic, but is anyone having wifi/Bluetooth issues with the pro 3em?

Yes @aka-swork 

Wifi Signal is very Bad, i had a much better signal with the 3em.
I have no WiFi signal at all, even within 50 cm. The same goes for bluetooth.... Shelly support keeps silence.

I have submitted a PR to add the counters we can from the device. Note that the device doesn't report energy counters so I apologize that most of you will probably be disappointed. I have discussed this with Shelly developers and they plan to add these counters, but I have no commitment when.

Please try to stay on topic, Thanks 👍
Keeping this open until we add the energy sensors
@thecode thank you for your work so far, and looking forward to getting the energy entities added once Shelly rolls out the update on their end.

Then after a couple of days, I started getting warnings saying "Unable to find referenced entities button.shelly_2_left_panel_reboot or it is/they are currently not available"

> 

OK will do, thanks

Just in case this issue and mine are related, I'm going to cross-ref my new ticket here:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/87100

I have locked this issue to prevent it being a garbage collector for other non-related issues. Changes in HA to enable energy sensors (https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/86476) are ready and waiting for device firmware.
Best option to make this happen faster is to remind Shelly we are waiting for the Energy sensor notification updates in `NotifyStatus`.

Shelly Pro 3EM will be fully supported with firmware `0.13.0-beta3` in the next core release (`2022.3.0`)
If someone is testing this and having issues, please create a new issue. Thanks 👍

I can't wait. Pro 3EM is working nicely in HA but the one fundamental missing feature is of course Energy. 
I am missing a lot of energy data since I deployed it. 
Considering the content of the device internal memory, will all missing data be restored into HA once support is full with 2023.3.0?

Thank you!
